zones.name: Generator Set Exterior
zones.description: Housing, identification plates, skid base, and acoustical materials

steps.procedure: Check door panels, hinges, and latches for damaged, loose, or corroded items. Inspect air intake and exhaust grills for debris.
steps.noGoCondition: Cannot secure door.

steps.procedure: Check to ensure identification plates are secure.
Inspect skid base for cracks and/or corrosion.
steps.noGoCondition: Skid base is cracked or shows signs of structural damage.

steps.procedure: Ensure that acoustical materials are free of damage and not missing.

zones.name: Engine Assembly
zones.description: Engine, fuel system, fuel filter/water separator, lubrication, radiator, hoses, cooling fan, water pump, and fan belt

steps.procedure: Inspect for loose, damaged, or missing hardware.
steps.noGoCondition: Any loose, damaged, or missing hardware.

steps.procedure: Inspect for leaks, damage, loose, or missing hardware.
steps.noGoCondition: Any fuel leaks, damage, loose or missing parts.

steps.procedure: Inspect for leaks, cracks, damage, proper mounting, loose or missing parts. Drain water from fuel filter/water separator (WP 0012, Service of Air Cleaner Assembly).
steps.noGoCondition: Any fuel leaks. Water not drained.

steps.procedure: Inspect for leaks, damage, loose or missing parts. Inspect oil level. Inspect for contamination. Refer to Lube Order LO 9-6115-641-12.
steps.noGoCondition: Class III leaks, damage, loose or missing parts. Oil level is low. Oil shows signs of contamination.

steps.procedure: Inspect for leaks, damage, loose or missing parts.

steps.procedure: Inspect for leaks, cracks, or missing parts.
steps.noGoCondition: Class III leaks or missing clamps or hoses.

steps.procedure: Inspect for obstruction, damage, or looseness. Inspect for unusual noise in fan area.
steps.noGoCondition: Damaged or loose. Unusual noise from fan area.

steps.procedure: Inspect for leaks.
steps.noGoCondition: Class III leaks or unusual noise from area.

steps.procedure: Inspect for cracks, fraying, or looseness.
steps.noGoCondition: Broken or missing belt.

steps.procedure: Inspect for loose, damaged, or missing parts. Inspect restriction indicator for clogged air cleaner element.

steps.procedure: Inspect for damage and looseness.
steps.noGoCondition: Damaged or loose.

zones.name: Winterization Kit (Before)
zones.description: Winterization kit, if installed. Complete the generator set PMCS first (WP 0010). Heater, control unit, fuel and coolant components, harness, switch lamp

steps.procedure: Check for damage. Ensure that heater assembly is mounted securely.
steps.noGoCondition: Damage that renders equipment unsafe. Heater not mounted securely.

steps.procedure: Check for loose or broken wires or damage.
steps.noGoCondition: Wires loose or broken or control unit damaged.

steps.procedure: Inspect fuel pump for leaks
steps.noGoCondition: Any fuel leak.

steps.procedure: Check for sufficient fuel.
steps.noGoCondition: Insufficient fuel.

steps.noGoCondition: Fuel lines damaged; clamps missing.

steps.procedure: Inspect heater for signs of leaks.
steps.noGoCondition: Class III coolant or any class fuel leak is detected.
